title: Magpie BBQ
style: Comedy pop with Aussie hip-hop bounce, swung percussion, beatboxed kicks, handclap snaps, and cheeky Spanish licks; verse rotates Corey, Michelle, Ruby, and Wez over a playful call-and-response groove. Pre-chorus strips to voice stacks and bass pops, chorus hits with gang vocals, harmony hooks, and slapback ad-libs. Ear candy: bird whistles, reversed swells, and a magpie-swoop riser. Bright, punchy, mischievous mix with close-mic comedy vocals and wide group chants., comedy, happy, oi
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
[Corey]
Corey happy, smart core
A I eye, eye sees more
Hawk eye in the sky
I see the chips, I see the pie

[Michelle]
Michelle, Mishy, Mish Mash
Pink drink thoughts in a splash
Pink milk drink, sip and grin
I rock up twice, then rock up in

[Ruby]
Ruby, roo roo, little spark
Quokka bounce in the backyard park
I say hola, then I say hey
Give me a lolly and I’m okay

[Wez]
Wesley, Wez, Wezza, mate
I nick the last snag off your plate
Bo bo, aye i i
I’m quick, I’m slick, I zoom by

[Pre-Chorus]
[Corey]
Reverse it, forward it, crack the code
Backyard brain on overload

[Michelle]
Pelican is what we reckon
Check one clue, then check the second

[Ruby]
Mi mini, bo bo, ping-ping-ping
Little brain with a giant zing

[Wez]
Sneaky step, then a cheeky grin
Oi, the whole crew’s caving in

[Chorus]
Aussie aussie aussie, here aha here
Aussie aussie aussie, loud and clear
Oi oi oi, we’re in the zone
Wez and Mish and Roo and Corey at home
Aussie aussie aussie, here aha here
Pink milk drink, then disappear
Magpie swoop, but I just say “no”
Aussie aussie aussie, let it go

[Verse 2]
[Michelle]
Micha, Wezza, bo bo, aye i i
We laugh so hard we cry, ay yi yi
Spanish lick on the end of the line
“¿Qué pasa, mate?” — too easy, fine

[Corey]
I map the mess with a backyard plan
One twig, two sticks, then it makes sense, fam
Smart as a possum with a borrowed key
I open the riddle, and the riddle opens me

[Ruby]
Galah gossip on the clothesline swing
I sing “mira, mira” at everything
If the day goes sideways, I skip and lean
Still got a grin in my sunscreen

[Wez]
Black sniffer poodle on a tiny patrol
He steals the show, then he steals my roll
Phonk panther sneaks past the shed
Then I yell “olé” and dodge his head

[Pre-Chorus]
[Corey]
Forward, reverse, then one more glance
I solve the thing and give it a dance

[Michelle]
Pelican peck, but the joke lands first
Laugh so hard that the bubbles burst

[Ruby]
Roo roo, yo yo, make that face
We’re the loudest in the whole place

[Wez]
Aye i i, we’re on the run
Too much cheek and too much fun

[Chorus]
Aussie aussie aussie, here aha here
Aussie aussie aussie, loud and clear
Oi oi oi, we’re in the zone
Wez and Mish and Roo and Corey at home
Aussie aussie aussie, here aha here
Pink milk drink, then disappear
Magpie swoop, but I just say “no”
Aussie aussie aussie, let it go

[Bridge]
[Corey]
If the magpie dives, I duck and slide
Hawk eye on the sky, I stay alive

[Michelle]
Mishy Mash says, “calma, calma”
Then she drops a grin and a tiny palma

[Ruby]
Roo roo, brother, pass the jam
I’m the queen of “sí” and “yeah, I am”

[Wez]
Wezza yells, “mate, watch your plate!”
Then we all break out, laughing
